title: San Diego Natural History Museum

services.name: Field trips
services.desc: Discover the wonders of the natural world through school programs designed to inspire and connect San Diego students with science and conservation. Bring your class to The Nat or let us bring the adventure to you with NGSS-aligned programs that spark lasting curiosity, with zero extra lift for educators. Programs can be booked during the school year, and we recommend scheduling early to secure your preferred date and experience. To get started, select your desired experience below. Immerse your class in millions of years of regional history with a Hands-On Workshop, Guided Exhibit Tour, or Self-Guided Visit. Admission is included, so your students can explore the museum or opt to see a film
